### 📖 About the Organization

*The Geographer's Craft* was initiated in 1992 at the **[Department of Geography and the Environment, University of Texas at Austin](https://liberalarts.utexas.edu/geography/)** under the leadership of **Dr. Kenneth E. Foote** and **Dr. Peter H. Dana** ([www.pdana.com](https://www.pdana.com/)), with major grant support from the **National Science Foundation (NSF)** Division of Undergraduate Education.

As one of the world's first open educational resources (OER) on the World Wide Web, it educated generations of geography and GIS students worldwide in spatial analysis, coordinate systems, GPS, map projections, error management, and cartographic design.

### 🏛️ NSF Grant Awards
- **[NSF DUE #9250310](https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=9250310)**: *A New Model for Teaching Geographical Methods in the Undergraduate Curriculum* (1992–1994)
- **[NSF DUE #9354476](https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=9354476)**: *Hypermedia Material for Teaching Geographical Techniques* (1993–1996)
- **[NSF DUE #9554947](https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=9554947)**: *The Geography Virtual Department: Building and Linking Geography Curricula Nationally* (1996–1999)
